Enjoy the full Hindi superhit comedy movie "Khatta Meetha" in stunning 4K resolution! Starring Akshay Kumar, Trisha, and Rajpal Yadav, this movie is sure to keep you entertained.
Watch it on TV for the best experience!
Sachin Tichkule is an ambitious contractor who faces opposition from everyone, both at home and at work. But he continues to struggle while his family members continue to pocket ill-gained money.
Khatta Meetha is a 2010 Indian Hindi-language political satire dark comedy film written and directed by Priyadarshan.
